description: Phase 3 (app: free play, loop station, AI compare, arrange, save/export, credits) of .omc/plans/music-loop-game-plan.md §6. Gates G1-G8 (§2), esp. G8 pad-first UI + keyboard toggle. Spec AC1-6, 8-13, 18-19. No stages UI (Phase 4), no CloudKit (Phase 5/G7). Device feel-testing is the user's step.

userStories.title: Instrument sounds: 4 roles x 2-3 timbres, license-tracked
acceptanceCriteria: Drums (kick, snare, closed hat, open hat, tom, crash), bass, keys/chords, lead: each role has 2-3 timbres; sources are CC0 sample libraries with verified license files, or sounds synthesized in code (license self); no CC-BY-NC/ND or unclear sources
Every bundled audio file has an entry in licenses.json and LicenseTests covers App/Resources/Samples (test fails on a missing entry)
Pitched timbres play any MIDI note in their role's range (bass 36-55, keys 53-72, lead 60-81) via resampling or multi-sample mapping; unit test for the note->sample/rate mapping
Total bundled audio <= 30 MB

userStories.title: Free play screen: pad instrument (G8) + keyboard toggle
acceptanceCriteria: Instrument + timbre picker, BPM 60-160 control, metronome toggle (AC1)
Drums: kit pad grid; bass/melody: pads holding only current-key scale notes (no out-of-scale pad); chords: one pad per diatonic chord of the progression, sounding Chord.voicing (G8)
Settings toggle switches pitched instruments to a 12-note keyboard (G8)
Pads use the UIKit touch path (UITouch.timestamp) and are NOT inside a ScrollView; multitouch
iPhone portrait and iPad regular-width layouts (AC3); simulator screenshots of both saved under .omc/reports/screens/

userStories.title: Loop station: record, loop, layer up to 8 tracks
acceptanceCriteria: Record a track with 1-bar count-in at the song BPM, chosen length 1/2/4/8 bars (AC5); recorded hits stored as Notes in ticks relative to loop start using the clock mapping (touch time -> frame -> tick)
Tracks loop sample-accurately through the existing Renderer (RenderState built from Song), up to 8 simultaneous (AC6); mute and delete per track
Unit test (LoopCore or app logic module): hits at known host times convert to expected ticks at BPM 60/110/160 within 1 tick
Next-instrument hint shown using Recommender (fixed order per G6) (AC12)
userStories.notes: Real touch recording not yet exercised on a device (simulator cannot tap pads) — user device test pending

userStories.title: AI compare after recording (AC10-13)
acceptanceCriteria: After each recording, run Corrector on the take and show Compare: original + 1-2 passing candidates (or original + 'no suggestion' notice); user can audition each and pick one to keep (AC10)
Never shows an unfiltered candidate; works offline (no network APIs used) (AC11, AC13)
Corrector call happens off the main thread and the UI stays responsive; unit test that the compare model exposes only Metrics-passing candidates

userStories.title: Arrange, save/load, export audio (AC8-9, 18-19)
acceptanceCriteria: Arrange screen shows Arranger sections (intro/main/outro) and lets the user toggle tracks per section (AC8-9); song total shown and >= 60 s
Songs saved as JSON (Song Codable) in Application Support, listed, reopened and edited (AC18); round-trip test through the file layer
Export renders offline with the same Renderer to m4a (AAC) and wav, shared via ShareLink (AC19); test: exported buffer length equals arrangement frames (m4a file length within +-2112 frames)

userStories.title: Credits + app shell
acceptanceCriteria: Credits screen lists every CC-BY item from licenses.json with attribution (Groove MIDI etc.) (AC4)
App shell: home (new song / my songs / free play), navigation between screens; S1 spike screen removed or moved behind a debug-only entry
App builds for simulator and device (id of connected iPhone if present) with no errors; LoopCore swift test passes
